ITEM 1 | Shredded orange carrot strands, thin matchstick-like threads about 0.2 cm thick and 5-8 cm long, bright orange with slight sheen, forming a loose mound across the bottom and left side of a stainless steel bowl about 20 cm across, roughly 2 cm tall | 85
ITEM 2 | Thinly sliced red onion rings and half-moons, pale white with purple-magenta edges, slightly translucent, separated into loose curved pieces about 0.2 cm thick and 4-8 cm long, scattered over the carrot on the upper and left portion of the bowl, roughly 2 cm tall | 45
ITEM 3 | Thin irregular flakes or shavings of pale cream-white hard cheese, matte surface with slight granular texture, about 2-4 cm across and 0.1-0.2 cm thick, scattered among the carrot and onion mostly on the right side of the bowl | 30
